purpose: Teach: 行お/コンパイラ/スタック/アクセシビリティ/ラーニング/ウィークリー/インスピレーション/もうける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の検証を実際に行おう
lines.en: Ren, let's actually run the verification on this paper.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. A step forward in Ren's training—not harsh, but the tone of someone who expects follow-through. Slight pause after the name to ensure attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古いコンパイラの解析もおこないます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also analyze the older compiler systems.
lines.style: Quiet, focused commitment. Small inhale before speaking. Steady rhythm with slight emphasis on 'also'—showing he's already thinking ahead. No breathiness, just present and ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データ構造のスタックを学べ
lines.en: Ren, you need to study data structures and stack implementation.
lines.style: Direct but not cold. The tone of someone laying out essential groundwork. Name called first with a brief pause. Even delivery, like handing him a necessary tool.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室のアクセシビリティを改善します
lines.en: Understood. I'll work on improving the lab's accessibility and workflow.
lines.style: Respectful, almost formal—but genuine, not stiff. Slight nod in the voice. Careful pronunciation, showing he's taking this seriously. Ends with a small breath like he's already mentally organizing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、Eラーニングでも英語論文を学べ
lines.en: Ren, study English academic papers through e-learning too.
lines.style: Practical, almost gentle in its directness. The tone of someone who knows what Ren needs but isn't lecturing—more like handing him a key. Slight emphasis on 'through'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。ウィークリー研究ノートを書きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll write up my research notes every week.
lines.style: Eager but controlled. The sound of someone trying to impress slightly—not overeager, but sincere. Deliberate pacing. Small pause before 'every week' to show the commitment registers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、自然から研究のインスピレーションを得ろ
lines.en: Ren, draw your research inspiration from the natural world.
lines.style: Slower cadence here—almost philosophical. A moment of weight in the voice, like Hiroshi is offering something beyond the technical. Name first, then the larger idea. Warm but serious.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究で短期にもうける事は致しません
lines.en: Understood. I won't pursue short-term profit from this research.
lines.style: Formal, solemn agreement. Slight emphasis on 'won't'—showing he's understood the ethical boundary. Quiet but steady. Ends cleanly, like a vow. No trailing off, just quiet resolve.
